structure.warmup: 15 min easy jogging (Zone 2) + dynamic mobility + 4x60m progressive build-up strides
structure.main_set: 2 sets of (400m at 800m target pace [57s] + 60s rest + 300m at 800m pace [42s] + 45s rest + 200m all-out [27s]), 8 min active walking recovery between sets
structure.cooldown: 10 min easy jog + barefoot grass mobility

title: Mountain Trail Aerobic Base & Technical Elevation

structure.main_set: 14 km mountain trail run with 650m positive elevation gain. Uphill power hiking at Zone 2/3 (HR < 155 bpm), cadence-controlled downhill running with relaxed knee flexion
structure.cooldown: 5 min gentle walking + calf stretches against incline

title: Subacute Hamstring Heavy Slow Resistance & Isometrics

structure.warmup: 8 min stationary bike (cadence > 90 rpm, low resistance) + 2x15 bodyweight glute bridges
main_set: 1. Prone Isometric Knee Flexion Hold at 30 deg: 5 sets x 45 sec holds (70% MVC, 60s rest)
2. High-Bench Single-Leg Hip Thrust: 3 sets x 8 reps per side (3s concentric, 3s eccentric, RPE 7)
3. Seated Leg Curl HSR: 3 sets x 6 reps at 75% 1RM (3s up, 3s down, zero explosive momentum)
4. Askling 'The Diver': 3 sets x 6 reps per leg (focus on pelvic neutral stability)
structure.cooldown: 5 min light bike spin + gentle diaphragmatic breathing (no aggressive static stretching)

title: Spine-Sparing Neutral McGill Big 3 & Glute Drive

structure.warmup: Cat-Camel gentle spinal mobilization (no end-range forcing, 6 slow cycles)
main_set: 1. McGill Modified Curl-Up: 3 sets x (6, 4, 2 descending pyramid) of 8s holds per side
2. McGill Side Plank from knees or feet: 3 sets x 8s holds (descending pyramid 6-4-2)
3. McGill Quadruped Bird-Dog with abdominal brace: 3 sets x 8s holds (descending pyramid 6-4-2)
4. High-Handle Trap Bar Deadlift: 4 sets x 6 reps at 60% 1RM (strict neutral spine, 0 lumbar flexion)
5. Barbell Glute Hip Thrust on Bench: 3 sets x 10 reps (pause 2s at top glute contraction)
structure.cooldown: Walking 10 minutes at brisk pace to restore neutral disc hydration

structure.main_set: 35 min continuous low-resistance cycling strictly capped at Heart Rate Zone 1 (< 120 bpm, RPE 3/10, nasal breathing only)
structure.cooldown: 5 min cool spin + 10 min full-body floor mobility and guided parasympathetic breathing (4s inhale, 7s hold, 8s exhale)

structure.warmup: 15 min Zone 2 easy running + 4x100m progressive strides
structure.main_set: 3 x 3000m at Marathon Race Pace (e.g. 3:55/km) with 2 min easy float recovery jogging (4:45/km)
